detailed_description: The HTML to JSX converter performs a lightweight browser-side conversion for common HTML snippets. Paste HTML into the input area, click Convert, and review JSX-style output in the second text area. The tool replaces common attributes such as class, for, tabindex, readonly, maxlength, and table cell attributes with their JSX names, converts HTML comments into JSX comments, and self-closes common void tags such as img, input, br, hr, meta, and link. It is useful for quick cleanup of small snippets, but complex React refactors, event handlers, dynamic expressions, and production component structure may still need manual review.
usage_steps: Paste an HTML snippet into the HTML input text area.
Click Convert to apply common HTML-to-JSX replacements.
Check attributes, inline styles, and event handlers manually before using the result.
Use the Copy button to copy the converted output.
usage_examples: Convert a small HTML card snippet so class attributes become className.
Prepare a simple form snippet by changing for attributes to htmlFor.
Self-close img or input tags before pasting a snippet into a React component.
Use the output as a starting point for manual JSX cleanup.
